_comment: Model manifest for the MediaPipe BlazeFace face-detection model assets. Both variants have been downloaded and verified. Baseline variant is set after benchmarking.
name: BlazeFace
_note_on_format: MediaPipe Tasks Python API (FaceDetector) accepts .tflite files via model_asset_path. The .task container format was not available at confirmed public download URLs at the time of Milestone 5 implementation.

short_range.description: Optimised for close-range selfie-style images. Best for faces occupying a large portion of the frame.
short_range.redistribution_notes: Licensed under the Apache License 2.0. Suitable for redistribution and commercial use.

full_range.description: Designed for faces occupying a smaller portion of the frame (half-body, group photos). Note: Incompatible with the python Tasks FaceDetector API.
full_range.redistribution_notes: Licensed under the Apache License 2.0. Suitable for redistribution and commercial use.
